verdict.rationale: CrewAI's enterprise introduction lists a "Webhook Streaming" feature to "stream real-time events and updates to your systems," which matches the story directly. However, it appears only as a one-line feature summary for the managed AMP platform, not the open-source framework. Missing for 10: documentation of event types and how to configure a webhook subscription, payload/delivery/retry details, availability outside the AMP enterprise offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
